source: Frontier's own localised strings as written in the maintainer's journal (Loadout Ship_Localised, StoredShips ShipType_Localised, Module* *_Localised, StoredModules Name_Localised), read 2026-09-20. These are the printed names the game itself uses; where EDCD's tables and these disagree (the Mk spacing on ships), these win. Module strings keep only the outfitting-screen names (ModuleBuy/ModuleSell/StoredModules); the ship panel's short forms ('FSD (SCO)', 'Frag Cannon') are another printed namespace and are not pinned.
